facts.fact: On 26 November 2026 in Rabat, the Caisse Marocaine des Retraites (CMR) and three public-sector mutual insurers (MGEN, MGPAP, OMFAM) signed agreements, under ACAPS supervision, to create a secure digital platform for the four bodies to share beneficiary data directly, with services due from March 2027.

systems.owner: CMR with MGEN, MGPAP and OMFAM

MAR.note: Only 'data protection regulation' mentioned in general terms; no law named.
Only CMR's own digital transformation strategy mentioned; not a national strategy.

facts.fact: The article says the CMR and mutual insurers' data exchanges will be governed by Law No. 55-19 on the simplification of administrative procedures and formalities.

MAR.note: The source does not say the law requires bodies to share data.

facts.fact: Morocco's pension fund CMR and mutuals MGEN, MGPAP and OMFAM signed a framework agreement and two specific agreements on 26 November 2026 for a platform sharing beneficiaries' data, so members no longer supply a pension certificate, with services due from March 2027.
